## Checks

- [ ] `./.claude/verify.sh` is green
- [ ] If this changes a gate, a threshold, a formula or a stage of a pipeline, the script's header comment is updated in this pull request (a decision-history record is added when the change is hard to reverse, surprising without its context, or settles a real trade-off; otherwise the commit body carries the reason)
- [ ] AI assistance, if any, is stated here; AI-written commits carry a `Co-Authored-By:` trailer
